_STRUMSIGHT_DIAG_TOKEN_NOTE: Intentionally empty (E14 audit H6): the diagnostics token is a SECRET and must never be committed (AGENTS.md 5). Inject it at build time with --dart-define=STRUMSIGHT_DIAG_TOKEN=... (or from a repository secret in the workflow). An empty token means diagnostics are disabled (AppConfig.diagnosticsUsable) - never an empty X-Diag-Token header.
